name: Magento 2 Coding Standards MCP
description: Provides comprehensive Magento 2 coding standards, security rules, and theme-specific patterns to help AI assistants write and validate compliant code. It supports built-in presets for Hyva, Luma, Breeze, and Porto themes to ensure context-aware development.
